I have a dark blue monopoly and $463 cash. The other players already own light blue properties, so I can safely buy this one.

I would block Claude from completing the light blue monopoly by owning Vermont. After purchase I would have $363 left.

I passed GO and collected $200. The light blue houses cost only $50 each, so Claude can build on them quickly.

Auctioning risks letting Claude acquire the property for less than $100. He would then own two light blues and only need Connecticut to complete the set. Buying now locks the block. The dark blue monopoly remains my primary win condition.

I can afford one dark blue house with the remaining cash, but I do not need to build this turn. Blocking Claude from completing the light blue set is a clear win. A cheap monopoly there would hurt me before I finish my dark blue houses.
